abstract: Neck tumors in newborns are very rare. Teratomas usually include all three germ cell layers, as well as tissues that are not native to the anatomic site of genesis. Teratomas of the head and neck make up a smaller percentage of congenital teratomas. Because of the external compression that oropharyngeal or neck masses produce, they can cause serious airway obstruction. In addition, the larynx or trachea may have an underlying lesion. We presented a mature, 1-day-old newborn with an isolated giant neck tumor and difficulty breathing. The intubation was successfully done and the entire mass was completely removed. Early neonatal life is explored to emphasize this challenge briefly with several interesting instances, including prenatal diagnosis, therapeutic alternatives, and ex-utero intrapartum therapy (EXIT) techniques.
abstract_ja: 新生児の頸部腫瘍は非常にまれである。奇形腫は通常、3つの胚葉すべての組織、および発生部位に本来存在しない組織を含む。頭頸部の奇形腫は先天性奇形腫の中で少数である。口咽頭または頸部の腫瘤は外部から圧迫を生じるため、重篤な気道閉塞を引き起こしうる。さらに、喉頭または気管に基礎病変が存在することもある。我々は、孤立性の巨大頸部腫瘍と呼吸困難を呈した生後1日の成熟新生児を提示した。気管挿管は成功し、腫瘤は完全に摘出された。出生前診断、治療の選択肢、ex-utero intrapartum therapy(EXIT)手技など、いくつかの興味深い事例を交えて、この課題を簡潔に検討するため新生児期早期を取り上げる。
